description: Adds facts the user confirmed (skills, experience, education, certifications, languages, target roles and cities) to the profile. Lists only grow: duplicates are skipped and nothing is deleted. A job with no start date is not saved; it is reported back so you can ask the user for it. Returns what was applied, what was kept and what was skipped, with reasons.

bio.description: Professional summary. Saved only when the profile has none, unless replaceSummary is true.

startDate.description: e.g. 2021-06 or 2021. Leave out when unknown (never guess); the entry is then reported back.

replaceSummary.description: true only when the user asked to replace their current summary.
